# 2026.05.14-04 — Transmission map module extraction

## Summary
Moved all transmission-map logic from `Context` class into a dedicated
`phise.modules.transmission_map` module.  The `Context` class now holds thin
wrappers that delegate to the module, preserving full backward compatibility.

## Motivation
Keep `Context` focused on structured storage, validation, and auto-propagation
of physical quantities.  Algorithmic/visualisation code lives in modules so it
can be used independently of the class interface.

## Files Modified

### `src/phise/modules/transmission_map.py` (NEW)
Public API (take `Context` as first arg):
- `get_transmission_maps(ctx, N)` — delegates to JIT kernel
- `get_transmission_map_gradient_norm(ctx, N)` — spatial gradient norms
- `plot_transmission_maps(ctx, N, return_plot, grad, save_as)` — full plot
- `plot_analytical_transmission_maps(ctx, N, return_plot, save_as)` — SuperKN analytical plot

Low-level JIT helpers (moved from `context.py`):
- `get_unique_source_input_fields_jit(a, ρ, θ, λ, p)` — complex input fields for a point source
- `get_transmission_map_jit(N, φ, σ, p, λ, λ0, fov, ...)` — numerical map over FOV
- `get_analytical_transmission_map_jit(N, p, λ, fov)` — closed-form SuperKN maps

### `src/phise/classes/context.py`
- Added import block for the 5 public symbols from `transmission_map`
- Replaced 4 methods with 1-line wrappers + `See :func:` docstrings
- Removed `from .archs import superkn, SuperKN` (no longer needed)
- Added module-level re-export of the 3 moved JIT functions for legacy code

### `src/phise/modules/__init__.py`
- **Not changed** — `transmission_map` is intentionally not auto-imported here
  to avoid a circular dependency (`superkn` ← `modules` ← `transmission_map`
  ← `superkn`).  Users import it explicitly:
  ```python
  from phise.modules import transmission_map as tm
  ```

## Circular Import Notes
`classes/archs/superkn.py` imports `from ...modules import mmi, phase`, which
triggers `modules/__init__.py`.  If `transmission_map` were in `__init__.py` it
would re-import `superkn` while it is still loading → circular.  The safe
ordering relies on the fact that `context.py` is loaded **after** `archs` in
`classes/__init__.py`, so the `context.py` import of `transmission_map`
(which imports `superkn`) always finds a fully-initialized module.

## Breaking Changes
None — all four original `Context` methods remain with identical signatures.

## Physics Validation
No algorithmic changes; only code organisation.  Existing tests cover the
physical correctness of the underlying computations.
